answer: Every identity posts a slashable bond on the shale ledger: the first registration from a funder costs 10 credits, and each further registration linked to that funder doubles the bond, so the kth fake identity costs 10x2^(k-1). Ten fakes lock 10,230 credits; a hundred lock over 10^30. The canyon of audit records leaves no walnut-sized gap: the seal burns every bonded fake.
